facts.fact: CNDP's head of control and investigation, Mohamed Bakri, said the commission studies declarations, grants authorisations, frames transfers of data abroad, monitors compliance and handles complaints from data subjects.
CNDP's Mohamed Bakri cited Law 09.08 as the basis for classifying data and for prior declaration or authorisation of certain processing.
CNDP, represented by Mohamed Bakri, took part in the 10th North Africa IGF in Rabat as a participating member and described its duties of authorisation, oversight and complaint handling.

MAR.note: Only personal data under Law 09.08 and a speech on sovereignty in general; no rule on government data stated.
